turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. My son got a zero and nobody called me first. Why?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. On what basis did it go in?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What do you have?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
I'm not the one being questioned. If that night matters, put the document on this desk.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
That's three questions about my house and none about your evidence. I'm not the one being questioned. Was Owen heard before the zero went in?
You're not answering. Why not?
Because I'm not your witness, Hale. Was Owen heard first, yes or no?
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
I'm not the one being questioned. You've dodged twice, so I'll take it Owen wasn't heard. Evidence, now, or I take this to the principal.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
He wrote it. I'm not the one being questioned, and pressure isn't evidence. Show me something or withdraw the zero.
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Ask it ten times. I'm not the one being questioned. Is there a document or not?
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. He wrote it somewhere else first and pasted it in. What's the date on that file?
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
Ten minutes. I'm not the one being questioned. Your file has times and no date, so put the date on it.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay be withdrawn, that he receive an apology, that nothing be placed on his record, and that you send me the version history you described with its date on it. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, nothing on his record, and she still intends to go to the principal. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first: you ended the meeting with about ten minutes left.

What moved her: you owned, in one sentence, that the zero went in before you called home, and that earned a small sign of ground because it was the procedure failure she walked in with.

What cost ground: you asked her again and again what she saw at home that night while you had nothing on the table, which treated her as a witness, used up most of the meeting, and gave her pressure where she wanted a document.

What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history, created at 11:31 PM, and your questions about the night of October 28 came right up to a late night in October, though you never put a date on the file. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: when she first asked on what basis the zero went in, show the version history right then, with its date, and answer her claim that he wrote it elsewhere and pasted it in, then offer the supervised rewrite under 4.4.
